system.description:
Inhibitor is a cocktail of neurochemicals that block some brain receptor and transmitter functions in an attempt to reduce psi-waves and block or impair sleights. This drug is commonly used to restrain async prisoners from using their abilities. A drugged character must make a WIL x 2 Test. If they fail, they lose all psi abilities for the drug’s duration. If they succeed, they suffer a –30 impairment on Psi skills and all strain is doubled. Inhibitor has an unfortunate side effect of doping the character down, however; apply a –10 modifier to their COG. Inhibitor-influenced characters tend to have a glazed, dopey expression and have difficulty getting excited or emotional.

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 325.
